items.name: Chicken Corn Soup
items.description: Classic warm broth with shredded chicken, sweet corn kernels, egg ribbons, and house condiments.

items.name: Hot & Sour Soup
items.description: Rich spicy and tangy soup prepared with chicken, mushrooms, bamboo shoots, and black pepper.

items.name: Urban Special Family Soup Bowl
items.description: Hearty sharing bowl with chicken, prawns, vegetables, and crispy crackers.

items.description: Choice of signature burger served with seasoned fries and chilled soft beverage. [TODO: Confirm exact deal inclusions with owner]

items.name: Chicken Cashew
items.description: Wok-seared chicken cubes tossed with roasted cashew nuts, bell peppers, and savory oyster-garlic glaze.

items.name: Beef Chilli Dry
items.description: Tender julienne beef stir-fried with green chillies, ginger, and scallions, served with steamed or fried rice.

items.name: Chicken Manchurian
items.description: Boneless chicken in classic tangy tomato-garlic gravy, ideal with egg fried rice.

items.name: Buffalo Wings
items.description: Crispy chicken wings glazed in tangy buffalo pepper sauce, served with ranch dip.

items.name: Loaded Fries
items.description: Golden french fries layered with seasoned chicken chunks, melted cheese sauce, jalapenos, and house drizzle.

items.name: Crispy Finger Fish
items.description: Crumb-fried fish strips served with tartar sauce and seasoned fries.

items.name: Chicken Chowmein
items.description: Wok-tossed egg noodles with julienne chicken, cabbage, carrots, capsicum, and dark soy seasoning.

items.name: American Chopsuey
items.description: Crispy fried noodles topped with sweet and tangy vegetable-chicken gravy and a fried egg.

items.name: Urban Special Mix Platter
items.description: Assorted sharing platter with grilled chicken, wings, loaded fries, garlic bread, and dips. [TODO: Confirm platter items with owner]

items.name: Chinese Rice & Gravy Platter
items.description: Combination serving of egg fried rice, chicken chowmein, and choice of Chinese gravy.

items.name: Creamy Russian Salad
items.description: Chilled diced apples, potatoes, peas, carrots, and pineapple folded in lightly sweetened dressing.

items.name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
items.description: Crisp iceberg lettuce, herb-grilled chicken strips, croutons, olives, and parmesan dressing.

items.name: Urban Pizza
items.description: House special pizza topped with marinated chicken, beef pepperoni, mushrooms, olives, bell peppers, and mozzarella.

items.name: Pepperoni Pizza
items.description: Stone-baked crust layered with rich tomato herb sauce, generous mozzarella, and spiced pepperoni slices.

items.name: Chicken Fajita Pizza
items.description: Mexican-spiced chicken strips, onions, green peppers, olives, and melted mozzarella cheese.

items.name: Jalapeno Burger
items.description: Signature fillet topped with pickled jalapenos, melted cheddar slice, crisp lettuce, and spicy jalapeno mayo.

items.name: Zinger Burger
items.description: Golden crispy fried chicken breast fillet with lettuce and classic house sauce in a sesame bun, served with fries.

items.name: Urban Grilled Beef Burger
items.description: Char-grilled seasoned beef patty with caramelized onions, cheese, and smoky burger sauce.

items.name: Urban Special Club Sandwich
items.description: Triple-decker toasted bread layered with grilled chicken, fried egg, cheese, cucumber, tomato, and coleslaw with fries.

items.name: Grilled Chicken Panini Sandwich
items.description: Warm pressed sandwich filled with herb-marinated chicken, jalapenos, olives, and melted cheese.

items.name: Egg Fried Rice
items.description: Fragrant basmati rice wok-tossed with fluffy egg, spring onions, carrots, and light soy seasoning.

items.name: Chicken Masala & Garlic Rice
items.description: Aromatic garlic-infused fried rice topped with stir-fried chicken and crisp vegetables.

items.name: Monterrey Chicken
items.description: Grilled chicken breast topped with rich savory sauce, melted cheese, sauteed vegetables, and mashed potatoes.

items.name: Wild Mushroom Chicken
items.description: Pan-seared chicken fillet finished in creamy roasted wild mushroom and herb reduction with side vegetables.

items.name: Tarragon Chicken
items.description: Tender grilled chicken served in aromatic French tarragon cream sauce with potato sides.

items.name: Lemon Butter Grilled Fish
items.description: Boneless fish fillet grilled with lemon-butter herb glaze, served with sauteed vegetables and fries.

items.name: Crispy Golden Fried Prawns
items.description: Batter-fried prawns served with garlic mayo and sweet chilli dipping sauces.

items.name: Chicken Mushroom Pasta
items.description: Penne or fettuccine tossed in velvety white cream sauce with grilled chicken strips, button mushrooms, and herbs.

items.name: Creamy Alfredo Pasta
items.description: Classic fettuccine pasta folded in rich parmesan-garlic Alfredo cream sauce with seasoned grilled chicken.

items.name: Parmesan Pasta
items.description: Oven-finished creamy pasta topped with crusted chicken, aged parmesan, mozzarella, and oregano.

items.name: Moroccan Steak
items.description: Sizzling char-grilled steak glazed with signature warm Moroccan spice sauce, served with mashed potatoes and grilled vegetables.

items.name: Black Peppercorn Steak
items.description: Flame-grilled steak finished with crushed black peppercorn jus, seasonal vegetables, and potato sides.

items.name: Swiss Mushroom Steak
items.description: Grilled steak topped with creamy mushroom gravy and melted cheese on a cast-iron sizzler plate.

items.name: Mint Margarita
items.description: Refreshing blended fresh mint leaves, lime juice, crushed ice, and sparkling soda.

items.name: Oreo & Chocolate Thick Shake
items.description: Rich dairy ice cream blended with Oreo cookies, chocolate fudge drizzle, and whipped cream.

items.name: Signature Iced Cold Coffee & Shakes
items.description: Chilled espresso blended with milk, vanilla ice cream, and caramel or chocolate notes.
